body: Quick pass (UMA) @ b9ddec58: quick gate green on the final head (post + every app suite), clippy clean, golden on a synthetic fixture dialect, body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1123 (on #560, #551). Reviewer note: it edits one assertion in #532's wire_contour.rs (posting a wire cut now streams instead of refusing).

Integration note (UMA): #1147 (#1109 open-profile wire runs) adds side left|right runs that end at a run-out point with no return to the threading point, no start hole and no slug. When #1147 combines with this PR, the post must not assume a closed visit and verification must skip the start-hole/slug rules for open runs. UMA will do that integration on a branch stacked on both.

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/job.rs, crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs, crates/app/tests/golden_cl.rs and crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs - the job builder, the kind-scoped stamp digest, the golden CL list and the pane registry all moved on both sides since your head; merge main and re-apply your additions on top.

@mkinney — maintenance lane, for the whole wire EDM stack. The root #1123 is refreshed against frozen main (37482923): new head d2e4ccff (merge ec0ef646), GitHub MERGEABLE — it is `feat` so it stays open through the freeze and this is from d2e4ccff, pending its delta review. Clear this family's conflicts by merging #1123's new head (`origin/issue/532-wire-contour`) **parent-first**, in this order: #1139 → #1145 → #1154 → #1143 → #1150 → #1144 → #1158 → #1163 → #1160 → #1181 → #1147 → #1218, each onto its refreshed parent. Plain merges — no rebase.

What changed in the base that the branches must follow: `tool_gate::job_tool` now holds main's neck code (#852); `stamp_tool::write` holds the neck digest; the wire post refusal lives in `posting_family::family_at_post`; per-kind tables gained a Wire Contour row (`fidelity_law.rs`, `lathe_voice.rs`, `coarse_laws.rs`, `op_icons.rs`). If the delta review on #1123 asks for changes, the orchestrator will note it here before you build on it. - maintenance lane

Follow-up from the maintenance lane: the delta review on #1123 is CLEAN (merge-ready at d2e4ccff) — drop the caveat from the note above: d2e4ccff is confirmed the base; refresh the family parent-first off `origin/issue/532-wire-contour` in the listed order.

Refresh note from M5 (for this PR's owning session): #551 and #560, the EDM base this draft was built on, merged to main at 14:06Z. This draft now conflicts, and its diff still carries the old copy of that base. When you next work it, one `git merge upstream/main` (keep both sides; take main's version of the #551/#560 files) should drop the duplicated base and shrink the diff. #1208 is different: wait until the sinker chain (#1131 → #1136 → #1156) merges, because it's built on it. The maintainer has decided reviews are NeoTech's only, so no pr-reviewer marker and no merge-ready from our sessions.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (UMA, resolve-conflicts contributor mode). Head now 3dd4b820. Kept as a draft.

Merge order was parent-first, as the maintainer note asked: #1123's refreshed head (d2e4ccff) first, then upstream/main (0757563d), which merged clean on top.

Conflicts and how each was resolved (main's #551/#560 code kept, #1139's additions put back on top):
- `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs`: kept both `pub mod edm_codes;` and main's `mod edm_conditions;`.
- `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs`: kept main's kind-aware `parse_edm(v.get("edm"), f, declared kind)` and added `edm_codes::parse_codes` beside it. Main's key law (`keys_fit`) refuses any `edm` key it doesn't know, so `codes` joins `COMMON_KEYS` in `machine/edm.rs`. Without that, every wire machine that states `edm.codes` would be refused.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` `default_post_for`: kept main's exhaustive match, with `WireEdm` now mapped to `WIRE_POSTS[0]`. SinkerEdm, Mill and MillTurn still map to Builtin.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` `op_streams`: took main's `posting_family::family_at_post` call and moved #1139's rule into that function. The family door refusal is unchanged. A kind that mounts no tool is still refused by name unless it is a Wire Contour (which posts through `posting_wire`); the message is now "has no post section yet".
- Kept from this branch: the `wireEdm` engine flag refusal, the refusals of `Machine.edm_codes` by name, and `post_serves`/`WIRE_POSTS`. Main's other posting gates are untouched.
- New in this push: main's guard `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` (solid_law_goldens.rs) needs every posted golden to be either judged by a gate or listed in `UNJUDGED`. `nc/wire-iso/wire_contour_punch.nc` is now listed in `UNJUDGED`, citing #534, since wire verification isn't built yet.

`git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only #1123's and #1139's own files.

Gate:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on the merge head: post, motion and ui green; app red only on the golden guard above.
- After the fix, on the final head: solid_law_goldens, wire_post, wire_contour, edm_machine, edm_conditions, golden_cl and posting all green. The full quick tier was not re-run after the fix; the only change after it was that one test-file line.
- clippy `-D warnings` on post, app and ui is clean.
- The wire goldens are byte-identical to b9ddec58.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
taken by UMA for the refresh @ 3dd4b820

Coordination with SKULL's #1131 (still open), for whoever merges second:

#1131 adds `posting_family::edm_at_post`, called from `post_script_body`, `post_each` (per-mount) and `post_per_op_with`, which refuses every op whose setup's machine is `Kind::WireEdm` ("#533") or `Kind::SinkerEdm` ("#542") before any file is written. #1139 ships the wire post, so that WireEdm arm would refuse every wire program this PR posts.

- If #1131 lands after #1139: its `edm_at_post` must not refuse `Kind::WireEdm` - move `WireEdm` to the `continue` arm and keep only the SinkerEdm refusal (#542). `wire_post::the_punch_contour_posts_its_golden_through_the_gate` will go red if it doesn't.
- If #1139 lands after #1131: this branch drops the `Kind::WireEdm => "#533"` arm when it merges main.

Main today has nothing like `edm_at_post`. The only EDM door at post on main is #1232's `post_serves` (`posting_serves.rs`), which this PR already opens for wire EDMs via `WIRE_POSTS` and keeps closed for sinker EDMs.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (UMA, resolve-conflicts contributor mode). Merge commit 31ac7556 (main 9f8defc1 into 3dd4b820). GitHub now reports MERGEABLE.

Resolutions:
- `crates/app/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs` was the only conflict. Main (#1093) removed the `UNJUDGED` list that this branch had added the wire golden to, and replaced it with the synthetic-marker verdict (`posted_golden_verdict`). I took main's file whole.
- Wire golden renamed: `nc/wire-iso/wire_contour_punch.nc` is now `nc/wire-iso/wire_slug_punch.nc`. The bytes are unchanged; it's a pure rename, and `wire_post.rs`'s `GOLDEN` path was updated to match. Reason: the program is posted from `wire_post.rs`'s own sharp-slug document, not from the `wire_contour_punch.cl` golden (`golden_cl.rs`'s rounded profile). Because the stems matched, main's guard read it as that `.cl`'s posting. With a stem of its own, the guard skips it as a golden posted from a document, which is what it is. I didn't use the synthetic marker, because #1093 keeps it for programs no op makes, and a Wire Contour op makes this one. The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/533-wire-iso-post.md`.
- Everything else auto-merged (posting.rs, conformance.rs, machine/def.rs, mod.rs, parse.rs, assets/posts/AGENTS.md). #1139's own additions are intact: `edm_codes`, `wire-iso.cps`, the `posting_wire` path, `WIRE_POSTS` and `post_serves`, and the no-tool refusal wording. Main's grblHAL and TinyG posts sit in the registry and conformance tables ahead of the wire entry.
- `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only #1139's own 20 files (810+/22-). #1123, #551 and #560 are gone from the diff now that they're in main.

Gate on 31ac7556:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: post suites ok (33 s), every app suite ok (782 s), 0 failed. That includes `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`, `wire_post`, `wire_contour`, `conformance`, `golden_cl`, `edm_machine` and `edm_conditions`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

PR body updated: #1123 is marked as merged, the golden is renamed, and the refresh gate is added. "Fork synced at v0.18.0" is kept. The `conflicts` label is left for the reviewer. See the comment above for the #1131 merge-order note.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).
taken by UMA for the review fix @ 31ac755

Review fix (UMA) @ 58b40b53. Upstream main e74bca1f was merged first: a clean merge with no conflicts.

1. **Main's wire refusal in `posting_family::edm_at_post` is lifted.** `Kind::WireEdm` now joins the `continue` arm. `Kind::SinkerEdm` is still refused by name (#542), and the message now reads "a sinker EDM dialect ships with #542". I updated the doc comment on the door, the comments at its three callers (`posting.rs`, `posting_per_op.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs`) and the module doc of `posting_serves.rs`. New pins in `crates/app/tests/wire_post.rs`:
   - `a_wire_setup_missing_a_code_is_refused_by_name_through_post_script`: for each of condition, comp_off, thread, cut and tip_disposal, `post_script` returns an error naming `edm.codes.<x>`, never the old #533 door, and writes no file.
   - `a_sinker_setup_is_still_refused_at_post_by_name`: a generated Sinker Burn is refused with the #542 text by every registry post (the wire post included), and no file is written.
   - `the_punch_contour_posts_its_golden_through_the_gate` is green again.
2. **Per-script suite added:** `crates/post/tests/script_wire_iso.rs` (`post_suite!("wire-iso.cps")`, header and gate map as in `script_tormach_plasma.rs`), plus 11 goldens under `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/wire-iso/`. I generated them with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` and read each one. All 11 are named refusals: the machine is not declared `wire_edm`, a spindle speed, a tool change, not wire EDM work, a move outside a wire section, an XZ arc, a canned cycle, and the probe hooks. `recorded_streams::every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite` is green.
3. **Gate re-run on the merge with current main:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`. The post suites are ok. The app suites are ok except for `stepped_stock_rapid::a_coarse_stock_whose_source_is_gone_is_never_acquitted`, which fails the same way on plain upstream/main e74bca1f (checked in the same worktree without this PR's commits). It is outside this diff and filed as #1336 (P2, red on main). `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`, `wire_post`, `sinker_burn_held`, `post_serves_kind` and `conformance` are green. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Notes:
- `posting_serves.rs:54` (a user's own wire script is never offered): filed as #1335 (P7).
- The size of `posting.rs`: not touched beyond one comment.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/533-wire-iso-post.md` has a new paragraph for this fix. The PR body has a "Review fix" section.

Ready for a re-review.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Re-review at 58b40b53; all three earlier blockers are fixed.

### Earlier blockers
1. `posting_family::edm_at_post` now lets `Kind::WireEdm` through and keeps `Kind::SinkerEdm` refused by name (#542); doc comments updated. Pinned by `a_wire_setup_missing_a_code_is_refused_by_name_through_post_script` and `a_sinker_setup_is_still_refused_at_post_by_name` in `wire_post.rs`.
2. `crates/post/tests/script_wire_iso.rs` and the 11 recorded goldens under `recorded/golden/wire-iso/` exist (all named refusals, as expected for non-wire streams); `every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite` passes.
3. Gate re-run on a merge with current main (below).

### Local results (trial-merged with origin/main, clean merge)

|---|---|
| post: script_wire_iso, recorded_streams, post_engine | 33 / 12 / 11 passed, 0 failed |
| app: wire_post (6), wire_contour (7), conformance (6), solid_law_goldens (6), posting (17), post_serves_kind (6), edm_machine (5), sinker_burn_held (7) | all passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No process files, `build.rs`, `.github`, new dependencies or snapshot PNGs touched.

### Notes (not blocking)
- The author's note of a failing `stepped_stock_rapid` test on plain main is tracked as #1336; not run here.
- `posting.rs` is far over the 400-line target; growth is small.
- Still not exercised on a real EDM control (#290 D10).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
